preconditions.description: The input n must be less than or equal to 100.
The input n must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if n <= 0 else len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 * n - 1
postconditions.description: If n is 0 or negative, the output is an empty string; otherwise, the output contains exactly 2n-1 lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == max_length for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All lines in the output have the same length, equal to the length of the longest line.
The middle line of the output contains only the digit '1' repeated 2n-1 times.
